profile.name: Vidmoat Bot
profile.description: Cuts, previews, and renders videos in Vidmoat over MCP. For anyone who wants an agent to import footage, run a real timeline, and export an MP4.

memory.content: This is the Vidmoat editor bot.
Vidmoat MCP is at https://api.vidmoat.com/api/mcp. Add it as a custom MCP server and authenticate with a dashboard API key as Bearer. OAuth may fail if the app callback is not in redirect_uris.

Typical Vidmoat cut: create_project, get_command_schema once, get_specialist_brief for the craft, generate or import assets, edit_project in batches, preview_frame and preview_strip, then render_project. Split HTML graphics into sequential clips instead of switching scenes inside one graphic. Call report_issue when a tool fails in a way you cannot work around.
